If two non-zero vectors are added together, and the resultant vector is zero, what must be true of the two vectors?
Option A: They have equal magnitude and are pointed in the same direction.
Option B: They have equal magnitude and are pointed in opposite directions.
Option C: They have different magnitudes and are pointed in opposite directions.
Option D: It is not possible for the sum of two non-zero vectors to be zero.
